title: SelectiveMilk
description: Tired of losing your hard-earned positive buffs from a single bucket of milk? This mod makes milk only clear negative effects, keeping your buffs safe!
body:
**Tired of losing all your hard-earned positive buffs just because you needed to cure a single poison effect?**

In vanilla Minecraft, drinking a bucket of milk is a double-edged sword. While it saves you from dangerous negative effects like Poison or Wither, it also completely wipes away your expensive potion buffs like Strength, Speed, or Invisibility. SelectiveMilk completely revamps this old mechanic to bring a much-needed Quality of Life (QoL) upgrade to your gameplay!


**Smart Cleansing**: Drinking milk now intelligently scans your active status effects.

**Keep Your Buffs**: All your positive status effects (Strength, Speed, Regeneration, Haste, etc.) are entirely safe and will not be removed.

**Cure the Bad Stuff**: Only negative status effects (Poison, Wither, Slowness, Weakness, Bad Omen, etc.) and neutral ticks will be cleansed instantly.

**Vanilla Friendly**: It changes no items or recipes, keeping the pure vanilla survival feeling while fixing a frustrating mechanic.
